Name: (CP) VisibleLadders
Author: Imallskillzy
Description:
This content pack recolors all ladders and mine shafts in the Valley Mine, the Skull Cavern and the Quarry Mine. It includes config options for every floor "biome"  to change the colors individually, for colorblindness accessibility or for personal preference. The config is comparable with Generic Mod Config Menu and can be changed while in-game.

This is not considered a cheat, it doesn't show you where ladders will spawn, it merely recolors existing ladders to make them more visible. This was designed originally for those who like to use the Zoom Level mod to zoom far out to scout for ladders, but had difficulty seeing them amongst the rocks of the floor.
